thread.title: Singapore Bourse May Extend Monday's Losses

title: Singapore Bourse May Extend Monday's Losses
text:
Singapore Bourse May Extend Monday's Losses November 19, 2018, 06:30:00 Singapore stock market on Monday halted the two-day winning streak in which it had gathered almost 40 points or 1.3 percent. The Straits Times Index now rests just above the 3,065-point plateau and the losses may accelerate on Tuesday.
 STI finished modestly lower on Monday following losses from the financials and the industrials, while the property stocks were mixed.
For the day, the index sank 18.53 points or 0.60 percent to finish at 3,065.07 after trading between 3,054.95 and 3,084.71. Volume was 1.01 billion shares worth 703.3 million Singapore dollars. There were 213 decliners and 172 gainers.
Among the actives, Hutchison Port Holdings plummeted 1.96 percent, while Yangzijiang Shipbuilding plunged 0.78 percent, Thai Beverage tumbled 0.76 percent, Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation skidded 0.63 percent, United Overseas Bank dropped 0.61 percent, CapitaLand Commercial Trust retreated 0.58 percent, DBS Group declined 0.51 percent, Keppel Corp added 0.48 percent, Comfort DelGro shed 0.46 percent, CapitaLand Mall Trust gained 0.46 percent, Ascendas REIT lost 0.39 percent, SembCorp Industries fell 0.37 percent, CapitaLand picked up 0.32 percent and Golden Agri-Resources, SingTel, Genting Singapore and Wilmar International were unchanged.
 ( AAPL )
Closer to home, Singapore will release Q3 figures for wholesale sales later today; in the three months prior, sales were up 2.4 percent on quarter and 10.3 percent on year. //www.rttnews.com/2956356/singapore-bourse-may-extend-monday-s-losses.aspx
